    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

normal = root / 'target/tooling/syntax-kind-tables/after-jscycles'

assert set(starting) == set(previous_inputs)
assert {name for name in starting if starting[name] != previous_inputs[name]} == {'scripts/mutation.py', 'scripts/test_mutation.py'}
assert sha(normal) == sha(root / 'target/release/jscycles') == previous['performance']['dense_final']['report']['binaries']['after']['sha256']
assert sha(profile) == previous['performance']['profile_binary']['sha256']
env = dict(os.environ)
env.pop('HOTPATH_OUTPUT_PATH', None)
cases = []
for name in ['fan-in', 'call-heavy', 'monorepo', 'directory-index', 'dense']:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='jscycles-profiling-cost-') as temporary:
        fixture = Path(temporary)
        files = 64 if name == 'dense' else 1000
        _, arguments, expected_file, expected_package = create_corpus(fixture, files, 'call-heavy' if name == 'dense' else name, 16, 512)
        if name == 'dense':
            for path in fixture.glob('module*.ts'):
                path.write_text(path.read_text() + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'Math.abs({i});' for i in range(12, 1000)))
        fingerprint = hashlib.sha256()
        for path in sorted(fixture.rglob('*')):
            if path.is_file():
                fingerprint.update(str(path.relative_to(fixture)).encode() + b'\0' + path.read_bytes())
        timings = {phase: [] for phase in ['normal', 'dormant', 'active']}
        expected = None
        output = area / f'overhead-{name}-hotpath.json'
        for sample in range(22):
            order = list(timings)
            offset = sample % 3
            order = order[offset:] + order[:offset]
            if sample % 2:
                order.reverse()
            for phase in order:
                executable = normal if phase == 'normal' else profile
                environment = dict(env)
                if phase == 'active':
                    output.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    environment['HOTPATH_OUTPUT_PATH'] = str(output)
                start = time.perf_counter()
                result = subprocess.run([str(executable), str(fixture), *arguments, '--json'], env=environment, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
                elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
                assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stderr, result.stderr
                report = json.loads(result.stdout)
                assert report['has_cycles'] and len(report['file_cycles']) == expected_file
                assert all(len(package['cycles']) == 1 for package in report['file_cycles'])
                assert len(report['package_cycles']) == expected_package
                if name == 'directory-index':
                    cycle = report['file_cycles'][0]['cycles'][0]
                    assert len(cycle) == files + 1 and cycle[0] == cycle[-1]
                    assert len(set(cycle[:-1])) == files
                if expected is None:
                    expected = result.stdout
                assert result.stdout == expected
                if phase == 'active':
                    functions = json.loads(output.read_text())['functions_timing']['data']
                    assert any(row['name'] == 'jscycles::run' and row['sampled_calls'] > 0 for row in functions)
                    assert sum(row['calls'] for row in functions if row['name'].endswith('::extract_from_file')) == files
                if sample:
                    timings[phase].append(elapsed)
        medians = {phase: statistics.median(values) for phase, values in timings.items()}
        cases.append({'workload': name, 'files': files, 'corpus_sha256': fingerprint.hexdigest(), 'samples_seconds': timings, 'median_seconds': medians, 'outputs_equal': True, 'active_report': {'path': str(output.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(output)}, 'active_function_timings': json.loads(output.read_text())['functions_timing'], 'dormant_change_percent': 100 * (medians['dormant'] / medians['normal'] - 1), 'active_change_percent': 100 * (medians['active'] / medians['normal'] - 1)})
assert starting == input_snapshot(root)
report = {'schema': 1, 'host': platform.platform(), 'samples': 21, 'warmups': 1, 'order': 'Rotate and reverse normal/dormant/active order on each sample of the same corpus', 'binaries': {'normal': {'path': str(normal.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(normal)}, 'profiling': {'path': str(profile.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(profile)}}, 'input_sha256': starting, 'source_unchanged': True, 'cases': cases, 'limits': 'Complete command timings include process start, enabled feature overhead and active report writing. Local synthetic evidence only; no per-span exclusive cost, production budget, customer latency or statistical significance claim.'}
